verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's docs describe phased workflows (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented, Freeform) chosen for the review points they give. They state that changes with unclear behavior 'need more review before implementation,' and reviewers can comment on synced task documents, which covers reviewing a plan before code is written. missing for 10: an explicitly documented plan-approval gate that blocks implementation until sign-off, detail on how plan artifacts are presented and approved, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
